Fig. 3. Comparative performance based on Accuracy (ACC). The line plot tracks the movement_libras dataset as a case study, followed by a Critical Difference diagrams over all datasets and average performance of the methods. Both MARS and Standard rank statistics agree on the superiority of the iterative approach. Only minor changes of positions observed with the inclusion of metric values in MARS.

The line plot tracks the movement_libras dataset as a case study, followed by Critical Difference diagrams over all datasets and average performance of the methods.
